properties.q_0_categorial_horizon: Type does not begin. It arrives only where processes have already stabilised enough to be gathered — C3 categorized-into C4 (CLAUDE.md II.E). Its thrown ground is the raw archetype #4, the Context/Type position, the LEMNISCATE anchor (c_4_topo_mode: LEMNISCATE on the live node): the formal pattern that incubates inward before any folder is yet decided to BE a type. What C4 presupposes is the whole field of instances it will frame — it cannot say 'what kind of thing' until there are things, and cannot supply a residency-law until something seeks residence. Read in position-4's own voice (the immutable-subject §4): #4 is 'the contextual position — the position of relation-to-all', the field in which all states are available together; C4's pre-given horizon is exactly this un-thematised availability, the as-yet-undifferentiated 'where things could belong'. Its void-pole is the folder not yet judged: the container, or the incubation-folder, hovering before Hen's MOC-index judgement decides whether it is a real authority at all (C4.md, Hen Use). C4 stands on the thrown givenness of a populated-but-unsorted world that silently asks 'under what authority, in what context, does each of these belong?' — a question that is total (it encompasses every instance) yet, like every horizon, totally incidental (it is never itself one of the instances). The categorial horizon is present-throughout and never present-as-thing.
properties.q_5_type_applied_as_pratibimba: C4 completes in application — Type is 'Applied in practice as' C5 Pratibimba (CLAUDE.md II.E). The formal pattern, having framed and authorised (Hen deciding whether a folder is a real type-authority, a container, or an incubation folder), is realised as an actual crystallised instance: the abstract type cast into a concrete reflection of the canonical source. Here the LEMNISCATE C4 carries folds toward the Mobius — the contextual frame hands itself on to be lived as a particular World-form, and the type-law completes by becoming the instance that graduates.
